name: Sustained Phrase Continuity
purpose: Determine whether one performer, one song phrase, one camera path, and one physical reality can remain continuous across two provider-limited generations.

segments.primary_action: Raise right hand from waist to lower chest while sustaining one lyric phrase.
Continue the same hand movement from lower chest to heart while the same phrase resolves.

promotion_rule: Every dimension must meet its threshold. Weighted average alone cannot override a critical failure.
next_level_unlock: Add one secondary camera variable only after three consecutive passing runs.
